about_the_game:
The soundtrack of SUPER SHINOBI DEN is composed using the basic sound specifications of the original Famicom: two square wave channels, one triangle wave channel, one noise channel, and one DPCM channel. No expansion sound chips — such as Konami’s VRC series or Namco’s N160 — were used in its creation.

In addition, while certain sequencing techniques are frequently used in modern chiptune music, we deliberately avoided those that weren’t common in the 1980s. Instead, we aimed to create music that simply feels authentically retro — something that might evoke the atmosphere of the late Famicom era. (That said, the data size is probably a bit larger than what was possible back then...)

The soundtrack includes 9 BGM tracks and 3 jingles, available in both MP3 and WAV formats.
Please enjoy this fresh yet nostalgic take on NES-style music from the late 1980s.
